title.zh-TW: GPT-6 Sol 與 Luna 模型上線，支援 Bedrock 並附帶舊版遷移提示
title.en: GPT-6 Sol and Luna Models Launch with Bedrock Support and Legacy Migration Tips

body.zh-TW: 如果你正準備挑選模型處理專案，現在多了 GPT-6 Sol 與 Luna 兩款新模型可供切換使用。⟦就像工坊添購了兩台新設備，連接著企業專用線路的廠區能直接啟用，操作台旁還附上了舊機型的換機指引。⟧習慣透過 Amazon Bedrock（AWS 提供的雲端模型託管服務）串接模型的團隊，現在也能直接選用這兩款模型。如果手邊的專案仍在運行舊版模型，也可以參考附帶的遷移提示，順利將工作過渡到新模型。
body.en: If you're picking a model for your project, two new models, GPT-6 Sol and Luna, are now available to switch to. ⟦Picture a workshop that just added two new machines: the facility connected to the dedicated enterprise line can power them on right away, and a replacement guide for the old models sits next to the console.⟧ Teams used to connecting models through Amazon Bedrock (AWS's cloud model hosting service) can now choose these two models directly. If your project still runs on an older model, you can also follow the included migration tips to move your work over to the new models smoothly.

items.original: Added GPT-6 Sol and Luna, including Amazon Bedrock support and migration prompts for older models. (#47332, #47347)

title.zh-TW: 背景伺服器自動啟動，遠端工作階段支援匯入指令
title.en: Background Servers Auto-Start, Remote Sessions Support the Import Command

body.zh-TW: 當你開啟互動式工作階段（與 AI 即時交談的操作階段）時，符合條件的環境現在會自動在背後啟動伺服器。⟦彷彿走進智能廚房時備料烤箱就已自動熱機，以前每次動工都要先手動啟動各台設備，現在一進場就能直接開始；遇到設定規格不合時，控制台還會主動提供調整方案讓你點選修復。⟧萬一伺服器設定與當前環境衝突，畫面會給出修復選項供你選擇，避免操作直接中斷。在遠端連線或本機背景伺服器的工作階段中，你現在也能隨時使用 `/import` 指令。
body.en: When you open an interactive session (a live conversation with the AI), eligible environments now automatically start a server behind the scenes. ⟦It's like walking into a smart kitchen where the prep oven is already warming up: you used to have to manually start every machine before getting to work, but now you can begin the moment you walk in; and when the settings don't match the spec, the console proactively offers adjustment options you can click to fix.⟧ If the server configuration conflicts with your current environment, the screen offers repair options so your work isn't interrupted outright. In sessions running on a remote connection or a local background server, you can now also use the `/import` command at any time.

items.original:
Enabled automatic background-server startup for eligible interactive sessions, with recovery choices when server settings are incompatible. (#47179, #47318)
Made `/import` available in remote sessions and local background-server sessions. (#47317)

title.zh-TW: 快捷鍵快速分岔對話，草稿與語音通話切換不中斷
title.en: Fork Conversations with a Shortcut, Drafts and Voice Calls Survive Switching

body.zh-TW: 你正在與 AI 討論專案，如果想開闢新分支探索不同方案，這正是按下 `f` 快捷鍵分岔對話（從既有討論衍生新分支）的時刻。⟦會議室另開一桌討論時，草稿與排隊待談的問題會跟著到新桌；在兩桌之間換位時，耳機裡的通話則持續進行。⟧透過這項功能分岔在其他應用程式中開啟的對話時，你尚未送出的草稿與排隊中的提示詞都會完整保留。當你在不同討論串之間切換時，進行中的語音通話不會被迫中斷。如果在回合結束時你輸入框裡還有未送出的回答，內容會自動恢復到輸入框中，而且不會干擾當前進行中的歷史紀錄搜尋。
body.en: You're discussing a project with the AI, and if you want to open a new branch to explore a different approach, this is the moment to press the `f` shortcut to fork the conversation (spinning a new branch off the existing discussion). ⟦When a meeting room opens a second table for discussion, the drafts and queued questions follow you to the new table; and as you move between the two tables, the call in your headset keeps going.⟧ When you fork a conversation that was opened in another application, your unsent drafts and queued prompts are all preserved intact. As you switch between discussion threads, an ongoing voice call is not forced to disconnect. If you still have an unsubmitted reply in the input box when a turn ends, the content is automatically restored to the input box, without interfering with any history search currently in progress.

items.original:
Added an `f` shortcut to fork conversations open in another app, preserving drafts and queued prompts. (#47185)
Preserved active voice conversations when switching threads. (#47381)
Recovered unsent question answers into the composer when turns end, without disrupting active history searches. (#47422, #47423)

title.zh-TW: 全螢幕對話紀錄預設開啟，終端機排版與選取捲動體驗升級
title.en: Fullscreen Conversation History On by Default, Terminal Layout and Selection Scrolling Upgraded

body.zh-TW: 當你需要在終端機裡查閱長篇回應、或是想跨行複製特定段落時，畫面空間與文字選取都很重要。對話紀錄現在預設以全螢幕顯示，並支援按住 Shift 鍵配合點擊來延伸選取文字。⟦跟把粗糙的黑白草稿換成排版講究的印刷手冊一樣，以前數學符號與清單容易擠成一團，現在符號排得整齊，也能拉著尺標連續標記整段文字。⟧畫面渲染也更加細緻，完整支援 Unicode（通用文字編碼）項目符號、核取方塊、對齊方程式與最佳化數學標記。當你在自動螢幕模式下透過 SSH（遠端連線通道）使用 Terminal.app 時，現在能再次使用原生捲動紀錄。終端機也會遵循 tmux（終端機多工工具）的滑鼠設定。
body.en: When you need to read long responses in the terminal or copy a specific passage across lines, screen space and text selection both matter. Conversation history now displays fullscreen by default, and supports holding the Shift key while clicking to extend a text selection. ⟦Think of swapping a rough black-and-white draft for a carefully typeset printed manual: math symbols and lists used to get crammed together, but now the symbols line up neatly, and you can drag along the ruler to mark an entire passage in one go.⟧ Rendering is also more refined, with full support for Unicode (universal text encoding) bullets, checkboxes, aligned equations, and optimization notation. When you use Terminal.app over SSH (a remote connection channel) in automatic screen mode, native scrollback works again. The terminal also respects the mouse settings of tmux (a terminal multiplexer).

items.original:
Enabled fullscreen transcripts by default and added Shift-click to extend text selections. (#47178, #47414)
Improved terminal rendering with Unicode bullets, checkboxes, aligned equations, and optimization notation. (#47191, #47322)
Respected tmux mouse settings and restored native scrollback for Terminal.app over SSH in automatic screen mode. (#47399, #47417)

title.zh-TW: 代理伺服器路由修復，檔案上傳支援重試並強化連線管制
title.en: Proxy Routing Fixed, File Uploads Gain Retries and Stricter Connection Enforcement

body.zh-TW: 在受管制或需要透過代理伺服器（替你轉發網路請求的中繼主機）連網的環境中，現在網路傳輸更加可靠且安全。⟦好比替物流轉運站加裝智慧閘門與重送輸送帶，以前遇到訊號微弱包裹就容易掉單、轉運路線也偶爾走錯，現在傳送失敗會自動重試且等候時間更長，遇到安全通行證被撤銷時也會立刻阻斷違規包裹。⟧過去即時連線與獨立網路搜尋在遇到轉址時，代理伺服器路由可能走錯，這個問題已經修好。上傳檔案時若遇到暫時性網路故障會自動重試，上傳逾時時間也延長至五分鐘。所有轉址與進行中的 HTTP（網頁傳輸規則）連線都會嚴格落實網路限制。WebSocket（即時雙向連線）也一樣；一旦安全規則變更撤銷了權限，連線會立刻被主動中斷。
body.en: In managed environments or ones that reach the network through a proxy server (a relay host that forwards your network requests), network transfers are now more reliable and secure. ⟦Like fitting a logistics hub with smart gates and a resend conveyor belt: packages used to get dropped whenever the signal was weak and transfer routes occasionally went the wrong way, but now failed deliveries retry automatically with a longer wait, and any package whose security pass has been revoked is blocked on the spot.⟧ Previously, live connections and standalone web searches could take the wrong proxy route when hitting a redirect; that problem is fixed. File uploads now retry automatically on transient network failures, and the upload timeout has been extended to five minutes. All redirects and in-flight HTTP (web transfer protocol) connections strictly enforce network restrictions. The same goes for WebSocket (a real-time two-way connection): once a security rule change revokes permission, the connection is actively terminated immediately.

items.original:
Fixed configured proxy routing for realtime connections and standalone web search, including search redirects. (#47101, #47142, #47204)
Added retries for transient file-upload failures and increased the upload timeout to five minutes. (#47122, #47393)
Enforced network restrictions across redirects and ongoing HTTP and WebSocket traffic, including cancellation when policy changes revoke access. (#47389, #47407)

title.zh-TW: 模型選單支援 GPT-6 系列，限流提示推薦切換 Luna
title.en: Model Picker Supports GPT-6 Series with Rate-Limit Prompts Recommending Luna

body.zh-TW: 當你連續請 AI 撰寫程式碼而發出大量請求時，最怕遇到對話中斷而打亂思緒。在模型選單（挑選由哪一款 AI 回答問題的切換清單）中，現在可以直接指定 GPT-6 Sol 或 GPT-6 Luna。當發送的請求達到上限並觸發限流（短時間內發送過於頻繁時暫停接收的保護機制）時，畫面跳出的切換提示現在會主動推薦改用 GPT-6 Luna 接手。⟦如同騎長途公路車遇到陡坡時，碼表直接跳出該換哪一檔的建議，以前得自己停下來判斷，現在照著提示換檔就能繼續往前騎。⟧如此一來，在密集調度不同模型資源時，便能直接順著建議切換，不必中斷手邊正在進行的開發任務。
body.en: When sending numerous requests while asking AI to write code consecutively, unexpected interruptions that break your train of thought are a major hassle. From the model picker, you can now directly choose GPT-6 Sol or GPT-6 Luna. When outgoing requests hit their cap and trigger rate limits (a protective throttle that pauses incoming requests when sent too frequently in a short period), the pop-up switch prompt now proactively suggests handing off to GPT-6 Luna. ⟦Much like a cyclist on a steep climb whose bike computer now suggests which gear to shift into: before, you had to stop and work it out yourself; now you follow the prompt and keep riding.⟧ This ensures that when juggling model resources heavily, you can follow the suggestion to switch directly without interrupting your ongoing development work.

items.original: Choose GPT-6 Sol or GPT-6 Luna from the model picker. The rate-limit switch prompt now recommends GPT-6 Luna. (#47405)

title.zh-TW: 全螢幕捲動效能升級，長對話與檢視器不再卡頓
title.en: Smoother Full-Screen Scrolling Eliminates Stutter in Long Chats and Artifact Viewer

body.zh-TW: 當你在全螢幕模式下翻閱篇幅很長的對話紀錄，或是打開產出物檢視器查閱內容時，快速滑動滾輪與觸控板變得十分滑順。以前手指快速滾動時，每一次細微的滾輪訊號都會立即觸發畫面重新繪製，不僅容易造成畫面卡頓，還會佔用大量處理器（CPU，電腦負責運算的核心）資源。現在系統會先將短時間內連續觸發的滑動事件合併整理，再一次性更新畫面，既降低了運算負擔，也消除了操作延遲。⟦如同收發室把同一時間寄達的零散信件整批捆好一次遞交，不必每來一張明信片就專程跑一趟辦公室。⟧
body.en: Rapid scrolling with a mouse wheel or trackpad is now much smoother when browsing lengthy conversation histories or inspecting content in the artifact viewer in full-screen mode. Previously, every tiny scroll event triggered an immediate screen redraw during fast scrolling, which caused visual stutter and consumed heavy CPU resources. The system now batches scroll events triggered in rapid succession before updating the screen all at once, reducing computational overhead and eliminating lag. ⟦Picture a mailroom bundling scattered letters that arrive at the same time into a single delivery, rather than running to an office for every individual postcard.⟧

items.original: Improved scrolling in the full-screen view: bursts of mouse-wheel or trackpad events are now coalesced before redrawing, which cuts CPU use and reduces scroll lag in long conversations and the artifact viewer

title.zh-TW: 額度或預算耗盡立即停損，不再空等數分鐘重試
title.en: Immediate Fail-Fast on Exhausted Quota or Budget Without Minutes of Retrying

body.zh-TW: 使用金鑰 `GEMINI_API_KEY` 進行操作時，一旦帳戶額度見底，系統會立即中斷並回報，不再讓你乾等。以前只要遇到每日配額（quota，平台允許呼叫的使用上限）耗盡、專案或帳單達到支出上限，或是預付餘額扣光，程式仍會花費數分鐘持續重試不可能成功的連線。現在遇到這類確定無法解決的狀況會立刻中止工作階段。至於每分鐘呼叫次數超標這類短暫限制，仍會自動重試。⟦好比去自動販賣機買飲料，發現卡片餘額不足時機器會立刻提示餘額為零，而不是反覆吞吐卡片空轉好幾分鐘。⟧
body.en: When operating with `GEMINI_API_KEY`, the system now halts immediately and reports the error once your account quota is exhausted, sparing you from waiting idly. Previously, when hitting daily quotas, project or billing spend limits, or running out of prepaid credits, the application would still spend several minutes retrying connections that could not possibly succeed. The session now terminates immediately upon encountering these permanently unresolvable conditions. Transient restrictions such as exceeding rate limits per minute will still be retried automatically. ⟦A vending machine immediately alerts you to a zero balance when your card lacks sufficient funds, rather than repeatedly ejecting and swallowing the card for minutes.⟧

items.original: Improved `GEMINI_API_KEY` sessions to stop immediately when the Gemini API reports an exhausted daily quota, a project or billing-account spend cap, or depleted prepaid credits, instead of spending several minutes on retries that cannot succeed; short-lived per-minute rate limits are still retried

title.zh-TW: 重新接續長對話瞬間載入，跳過重複動畫不再卡頓
title.en: Instant Resumption for Long Sessions Skips Replay Animations Without Lag

body.zh-TW: 當你打開先前篇幅很長的工作階段繼續提問時，畫面載入的速度變得俐落許多。以前在 `medium` 或 `low` 的詳細程度（verbosity，決定畫面要印出多少除錯與執行細節的設定）下恢復對話時，系統需要花上數秒重播所有歷史紀錄，造成操作延遲。現在先前執行完畢的工具會直接顯示為完成狀態，省去逐條重播動畫的時間。在載入過程中敲擊鍵盤，也不會再重新整理只載入到一半的對話紀錄。⟦就像翻開已寫好的會議紀錄，大家能直接從結論處接著討論，不必把每位發言者的發言逐字重唸一遍。⟧
body.en: Loading feels much crisper when reopening a lengthy prior session to continue asking questions. Previously, resuming a conversation under `medium` or `low` verbosity required several seconds to replay entire histories, causing UI lag. Previously completed tools now render directly in their finished state, skipping sequential animation replays. Typing on the keyboard during loading also no longer refreshes a conversation history that has only partially loaded. ⟦Think of opening completed meeting minutes where everyone resumes discussion directly from the conclusion, without reading every attendee's remarks aloud word for word.⟧

items.original: Fixed resuming a long conversation in `medium` or `low` verbosity taking many seconds and lagging while history replayed: earlier tool groups now appear already finished instead of each re-animating, and keys pressed during the replay no longer refresh a half-loaded transcript

title.zh-TW: 終端機多工器標題不再亂碼，修復圖片探測干擾
title.en: Terminal Multiplexer Titles Preserved Without Mojibake From Graphics Probing

body.zh-TW: 在多窗格環境下啟動工具時，終端機與分頁的名稱終於能正常保留。以前在 GNU `screen`、`tmux`（包含 iTerm2 的 `tmux -CC` 分頁）或 Zellij 等環境中開啓命令列時，標題每次都會被改成 `Ga=q,f=32,...` 這類奇怪的字串。這是因為系統啟動時會發送圖片支援的探測訊號，因而干擾了終端機多工器（將終端視窗分割成多個獨立工作區的工具）。現在程式不再主動向多工器發送圖片探測指令。若你確定需要開啟圖片顯示，依然可透過設定 `CLI_GRAPHICS=kitty` 強制啟用。⟦彷彿廣播系統取消了開場時刺耳的測試音，螢幕面板上的節目名稱再也不會被測試訊號給干擾覆蓋。⟧
body.en: Terminal and tab titles are now properly preserved when launching tools in multi-pane environments. Previously, opening the command line under GNU `screen`, `tmux` (including iTerm2 `tmux -CC` tabs), or Zellij altered window titles to strange strings like `Ga=q,f=32,...`. This occurred because the startup sequence sent graphics support probes, which interfered with terminal multiplexers. The program no longer sends graphics probes to multiplexers by default. If you still need image rendering, you can force it on by setting `CLI_GRAPHICS=kitty`. ⟦Like a broadcast system silencing its harsh opening test tone, the show title on the display panel is no longer scrambled by test signals.⟧

items.original: Fixed the terminal or tab title changing to a string like `Ga=q,f=32,...` every time the CLI starts inside GNU `screen`, `tmux` (including iTerm2 `tmux -CC` tabs), or Zellij; the CLI no longer sends its image-support probe through a multiplexer, and `CLI_GRAPHICS=kitty` still forces image mode

title.zh-TW: Vim 模式多項修正，支援中文字元搜尋與選取復原
title.en: Multiple Vim Mode Fixes Support Non-ASCII Character Search and Selection Undo

body.zh-TW: 偏好使用 Vim 模式編輯指令與文字的讀者，現在輸入非英文字元或選取段落時順手許多。以前在 `r`、`f`、`F`、`t` 與 `T` 指令後輸入 `é` 或 `中` 等非 ASCII 字元（非英文字母與標準符號的文字）時會被直接忽略。在可視模式（Visual mode，反白選取文字的模式）下使用 `fv` 與 `fV` 會意外跳出選取，無法順利延伸範圍。當執行 `D`、`C` 或可視狀態下的 `~`、`u`、`U` 但沒有變動文字時，以前還會多記一筆空白復原紀錄並清空重做歷程。現在這些編輯問題都已修正完畢。⟦宛如操作高階文書軟體，跳躍搜尋中文字能精確定位，反白選取時不會無故中斷，就算誤觸沒有作用的按鍵也不會清空復原歷程。⟧
body.en: Editing commands and text in Vim mode is now significantly smoother when typing non-English characters or selecting blocks. Previously, non-ASCII characters such as `é` or `中` were silently ignored after `r`, `f`, `F`, `t`, and `T` commands. Using `fv` and `fV` in Visual mode inadvertently exited the selection instead of extending the range. Furthermore, executing `D`, `C`, or Visual mode `~`, `u`, and `U` without modifying text recorded an empty undo entry and wiped the redo history. All of these editing glitches have now been resolved. ⟦Much like working in an advanced text editor, jumping to Chinese characters lands accurately, highlighting text does not abruptly cancel, and hitting ineffective keys will not wipe your redo history.⟧

items.original: Fixed Vim mode ignoring non-ASCII characters such as `é` or `中` after `r`, `f`, `F`, `t` and `T`, `fv` and `fV` in Visual mode leaving Visual mode instead of extending the selection, and `D`, `C`, or Visual `~`/`u`/`U` recording an empty undo step and clearing redo history when they changed nothing

title.zh-TW: 模型推理解析度支援分級，旗標與選單皆可自訂力度
title.en: Tiered Reasoning Effort Support for Models, Configurable via Flag and Menu

body.zh-TW: 當你需要模型處理繁複的架構設計或快速回覆簡短提問時，能自由調配思考深度就顯得格外實用。Antigravity 改進了不同模型對推理解析度（reasoning effort，模型產生答案前的思考運算深度）的支援，讓支援不同思考力度的模型能更精準切換層級。現在只要在啟動指令加上 `--effort` 旗標，或在對話中輸入 `/effort` 與 `/model`，就能從視覺化量表直接挑選適合的強度。⟦就像騎變速自行車依路況切換檔位，遇到陡峭山路時切換到高檔全力衝刺，平坦直路則換上輕檔快速巡航。⟧ 遇到棘手的重構難題時拉高力度，寫簡短測試或整理資料時調低檔位，思考資源運用更靈活。
body.en: When you need a model to tackle complex architectural designs or quickly answer brief questions, the freedom to adjust thinking depth is especially useful. Antigravity improves support for reasoning effort across different models, allowing models with varying reasoning capabilities to switch levels more precisely. You can now select the right intensity directly from a visual gauge by adding the `--effort` flag to startup commands or running `/effort` and `/model` during a session. ⟦Like shifting gears on a bicycle to match the terrain, a rider shifts into a higher gear for full power on steep climbs and cruises in a lighter gear on flat roads.⟧ Dial up the effort for tricky refactoring tasks and lower it for short tests or data organization, making your thinking resources far more flexible.

items.original: Improved reasoning effort level for models with different support, selectable with `--effort` or from the effort gauge in `/effort` and `/model`.

title.zh-TW: 需要設定參數的手動外掛改為預設停用
title.en: Manually Added Plugins That Need Configuration Now Start Disabled

body.zh-TW: 平時若是習慣直接把擴充套件檔案複製到設定資料夾，要注意這些外掛的啟用方式變了。以前直接放進 `~/.gemini/config/plugins` 目錄的外掛，只要內含需要設定參數的 MCP（Model Context Protocol，讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）伺服器，往往一放進去就嘗試運作；現在它們預設會先保持停用，直到你主動啟用為止。這樣的行為已與透過 `/plugin` 指令安裝的外掛完全一致。⟦如同收到需要裝上電池才能運轉的新家電，出廠時預設切在斷電安全檔，一定要先裝妥配件並手動按下開關才會啟動。⟧
body.en: If you usually copy plugin files directly into the configuration folder, note that these plugins now start up differently. Previously, plugins placed directly in the `~/.gemini/config/plugins` directory would attempt to run immediately if they contained MCP servers requiring configuration parameters; now, they remain disabled by default until you explicitly enable them. This behavior now fully matches plugins installed via the `/plugin` command. ⟦Picture receiving a new household appliance that requires batteries: it arrives safely switched off by default, starting up only after you install the accessories and manually turn on the power switch.⟧

items.original: Changed plugins placed directly in `~/.gemini/config/plugins` so that a plugin whose MCP server needs configuration variables now starts disabled until you enable it, matching plugins installed through `/plugin`.

title.zh-TW: WezTerm 與 VS Code 終端機不再破圖，圖表改以純文字備援顯示
title.en: No More Garbled Graphics in WezTerm and VS Code, Falling Back to Plain Text Diagrams

body.zh-TW: 在 WezTerm 或 VS Code 內建終端機裡查看架構圖或數學公式時，畫面上不再出現一連串令人摸不著頭緒的亂碼方塊。過去輸出 Mermaid 流程圖或 LaTeX 公式時，終端機被誤判為支援 Kitty 繪圖通訊協定，導致畫面印出整排破圖字元；現在已取消這項假設，改以清晰的 ASCII 純文字備援格式顯示，確保圖表與排版內容都能一目了然。
body.en: When viewing architecture diagrams or mathematical formulas inside WezTerm or the VS Code integrated terminal, you will no longer see confusing rows of corrupted placeholder characters. Previously, when rendering Mermaid flowcharts or LaTeX formulas, these terminals were incorrectly assumed to support the Kitty graphics protocol, causing rows of broken characters to print on screen. Antigravity has removed this assumption and now displays them in a clear ASCII fallback format, ensuring that both diagrams and formatted content remain readable at a glance.

items.original: Fixed Mermaid diagrams and LaTeX rendering as rows of garbled placeholder characters in WezTerm and the VS Code integrated terminal; these terminals are no longer assumed to support Kitty graphics and now show the ASCII fallback

title.zh-TW: 關閉選取即複製後，成品檢視器釋放滑鼠控制並恢復快速鍵
title.en: Artifact Viewer Releases Mouse Capture When Copy on Select Is Disabled, Restoring Shortcuts

body.zh-TW: 當你在設定中關閉選取自動複製功能時，瀏覽產出的檔案內容不再被強制攔截游標動作。過去在 `/config` 裡將 `Copy on Select` 關閉後，成品檢視器依然會捕捉滑鼠事件，使得終端機原生的選取與複製快速鍵無法使用；現在檢視器已不再佔用滑鼠，終端機本身的複製操作能正常運作，按下 `Ctrl+C` 也會如期執行中斷或退出。
body.en: When you disable automatic copy on selection in settings, browsing generated file contents will no longer hijack your cursor actions. Previously, after turning off `Copy on Select` in `/config`, the artifact viewer continued to capture mouse events, preventing the terminal's native selection and copy shortcuts from working. The viewer now releases the mouse so your terminal's built-in copy operations function normally, and pressing `Ctrl+C` properly interrupts or exits as expected.

items.original: Fixed copying text from the artifact viewer when `Copy on Select` is turned off in `/config`: the viewer no longer captures the mouse, so your terminal's own selection and copy shortcut work, and `Ctrl+C` goes back to interrupting or exiting

title.zh-TW: 專案自訂代理支援修復，桌面端與無頭模式皆能正常選用
title.en: Project Custom Agents Fixed Across Desktop App and Headless Runs

body.zh-TW: 當你在專案目錄下配置專屬的輔助角色時，各個執行環境現在都能順利讀取到這些客製化設定。以前放在 `.agents/agents/` 目錄下的專案自訂代理，容易在桌面應用程式建立的工作區、已信任的工作區、使用 `--agent` 參數、以 `-p` 或 `--prompt` 執行的 headless（無頭模式，沒有終端機視窗的執行模式），以及 `/agents` 面板中找不到或無法選取；現在這些辨識問題均已修好，無論在哪種模式下都能直接指派自訂代理。
body.en: When configuring dedicated assistant roles in your project directory, every execution environment can now smoothly load these custom settings. Previously, project custom agents located in `.agents/agents/` were frequently missing or unselectable in workspaces created in the Desktop App, in trusted workspaces, when specifying `--agent`, in headless `-p` or `--prompt` runs without a terminal window, and within the `/agents` panel. These discovery issues have all been resolved, allowing you to assign custom agents directly in any mode.

items.original: Fixed project custom agents in .agents/agents/ not being found or selectable in workspaces created in the Desktop App, in already-trusted workspaces, under execution with --agent, in headless (-p / --prompt) runs, and in the /agents panel.

title.zh-TW: /config 新增中等詳細程度，摘要工具呼叫並保留指令回覆
title.en: /config Adds Medium Verbosity to Summarize Tool Calls While Keeping Commands and Responses Visible

body.zh-TW: 當你交辦複雜任務給助理時，既不想被整頁的工具呼叫與思考細節洗版，又希望能看清執行了哪些指令與最終產出。在 `/config` 設定選單中，現在新增了介於 high 與 low 之間的 medium 詳細程度（Verbosity，控制終端機輸出多寡的設定）選項。切換到這個模式後，助理會把一連串相關的工具呼叫與思考過程，整合成像是 `Explored N files` 這樣的簡短摘要。所有實際跑過的指令與產生的文字回覆，依然會完整顯示在畫面上。Verbosity 設定本身以及底下的每個選項，現在都附上了說明文字，清楚標示各選項會顯示與隱藏哪些內容。⟦好比閱讀晨會的重點簡報，後台密集的資料調度被濃縮成一行要點，關鍵結論與交辦指令依然完整呈現。⟧
body.en: When delegating complex tasks to an agent, you might want to avoid being flooded with pages of tool calls and thought details while still clearly tracking executed commands and final responses. The `/config` settings menu now introduces a `medium` verbosity option between `high` and `low`. In this mode, the agent groups a series of related tool calls and thought processes into concise summaries like `Explored N files`. All executed commands and resulting text responses remain fully visible on the screen. The Verbosity setting and each individual option beneath it now include descriptive text clearly outlining what is shown or hidden. ⟦Picture reading a morning briefing: intensive background data operations are condensed into a single takeaway, while key conclusions and assigned instructions remain fully visible.⟧

items.original: Added `medium` verbosity mode to `/config`, between `high` and `low`, which groups related tool calls and thoughts into concise summaries (such as `Explored N files`) while keeping commands and responses visible; the Verbosity setting and each option now describe what they show

title.zh-TW: 成品檢視器圖表渲染加速，多工器環境自動切換文字圖表
title.en: Artifact Viewer Accelerates Diagram Rendering and Falls Back to Text Diagrams in Multiplexers

body.zh-TW: 在終端機裡開啟圖表或數學公式時，畫面載入與按鍵操作現在更俐落。在支援 Kitty 圖片協定的終端機中，成品檢視器（artifact viewer，瀏覽產出圖表與文件的介面）會在背景預先渲染產物，打開瞬間就能看見 Mermaid 圖表與 LaTeX 算式。圖片改以較小尺寸一次上傳，使用 `Ctrl+=` 與 `Ctrl+-` 縮放不再閃爍。檢視器頁尾將置頂與置底提示整併為 `g/G top/bottom`，`m` 鍵會清楚標示切換模式（包含 diagram、LaTeX、ASCII 或 raw），並修復箭頭符號過早折行的問題。在 `tmux` 或 GNU `screen` 內若圖片無法傳入，系統會自動備援降級為 ASCII 純文字圖表避免留白，有設定穿透者仍可用 `CLI_GRAPHICS=kitty` 強制開啟圖片模式。
body.en: Viewing diagrams or math formulas in the terminal is now smoother across loading and key interactions. On terminals supporting the Kitty graphics protocol, the artifact viewer pre-renders artifacts in the background so Mermaid diagrams and LaTeX formulas appear instantly upon opening. Images are uploaded once at a smaller size, eliminating flickering when zooming with `Ctrl+=` and `Ctrl+-`. The viewer footer combines the separate top and bottom hints into `g/G top/bottom`, labels the `m` key with the active switch target (including diagram, LaTeX, ASCII, or raw), and fixes hints containing arrow symbols wrapping too early. Inside `tmux` or GNU `screen` where images cannot reach the terminal, the system automatically falls back to ASCII text diagrams to prevent blank gaps, while setups with passthrough can still force image mode using `CLI_GRAPHICS=kitty`.

items.original:
Improved Mermaid diagram and LaTeX rendering in the artifact viewer on Kitty-compatible terminals: artifacts are pre-rendered in the background so diagrams appear as soon as the viewer opens, images are uploaded once at a smaller size, and zooming with `Ctrl+=` / `Ctrl+-` no longer flickers between the old and new sizes
Improved the artifact viewer footer by combining the separate top and bottom hints into one `g/G top/bottom` entry, labeling `m` with the view it switches to (diagram, LaTeX, ASCII, or raw), and fixing hints that contain arrow symbols wrapping onto a new line too early
Fixed Mermaid diagrams and LaTeX leaving a blank gap inside `tmux` or GNU `screen` when the outer terminal supports Kitty graphics; the CLI now falls back to ASCII diagrams unless images actually reach the terminal, and `CLI_GRAPHICS=kitty` still forces image mode for setups with image passthrough configured

title.zh-TW: 終端機沙盒降低繞過頻率，失敗步驟標記與 Esc 鍵行為修整
title.en: Terminal Sandbox Reduces Bypass Requests with Refined Failed Step Labels and Esc Key Handling

body.zh-TW: 讓助理在終端機裡自動執行各項指令時，安全防護與按鍵操作現在更符合直覺。終端機沙盒（sandbox，在隔離環境中執行指令以確保安全的機制）現在經過改善，助理要求跳出沙盒確認的頻率明顯降低。助理現在清楚知道沙盒內的指令可以直接讀寫自己的 artifact 與 scratch 資料夾，而且就算前面某個指令曾需要跳出沙盒，接下來的指令依然會優先在沙盒內嘗試。執行結束且回傳非零退出碼的指令，其步驟標題已從原先的 `Errored` 正式改為 `Failed`。當終端機跳出建議下拉選單時，按下 `Esc` 鍵現在會先關閉選單，按第二下 `Esc` 才會中斷助理執行，避免選字時不小心誤按中斷。
body.en: Running commands automatically with an agent in the terminal is now safer and more intuitive. With improvements to the terminal sandbox, the agent requests to bypass the sandbox significantly less often. The agent now recognizes that sandboxed commands can directly read and write its own artifact and scratch directories, and it continues to prioritize the sandbox for subsequent commands even after an earlier command required a bypass. For commands that finish execution with a non-zero exit code, the step title is formally updated from `Errored` to `Failed`. When the suggestions dropdown is open in the terminal, pressing `Esc` now closes the dropdown first, requiring a second `Esc` press to interrupt the agent and preventing accidental cancellation during autocomplete.

items.original:
Improved terminal sandbox behavior so the agent asks to bypass the sandbox less often: it now knows sandboxed commands can read and write its own artifact and scratch directories, and it tries the sandbox first even after an earlier command needed a bypass
Changed the step title of commands that exit with a non-zero code from `Errored` to `Failed`
Fixed pressing `Esc` while the suggestions dropdown is open interrupting the agent's turn; it now closes the dropdown, and a second `Esc` interrupts

title.zh-TW: 自訂設定檔改為僅掃描當前目錄，巢狀項目需透過 include_only 指定
title.en: Customization Configs Now Scan Top-Level Directories Only, Requiring Nested Items via include_only

body.zh-TW:
當你在專案中自訂技能、規則或外掛目錄時，現在設定檔的載入行為變得更精確可預測。在 `skills.json`、`rules.json`、`agents.json` 與 `plugins.json` 這類自訂設定檔（customization，用於擴充助理能力與行為的設定）中，填入目錄路徑時現在只會載入直接位於該目錄下的第一層項目，行為與預設的 `.agents/skills/` 資料夾一致，不再自動遞迴載入所有子目錄中的內容。如果你想要引入深層子目錄裡的特定巢狀項目，必須在設定項目中透過 `include_only` 明確列出路徑，例如：

```
{"path": "shared_skills", "include_only": ["category/my-skill"]}
```

⟦就像打開收納盒只拿取最上層的物件，若要翻出深層隔袋裡的工具，就得在領取清單上明確標出該項目的名稱。⟧
body.en:
Loading behavior for customization files is now more precise and predictable when defining skills, rules, or plugins directories in a project. In customization files such as `skills.json`, `rules.json`, `agents.json`, and `plugins.json`, directory entries now load only first-level items located directly inside that directory—matching the behavior of the default `.agents/skills/` directory—rather than recursively scanning every subdirectory. To include a specific nested item within a deeper subdirectory, you must explicitly specify its path via `include_only`, for example:

```
{"path": "shared_skills", "include_only": ["category/my-skill"]}
```

⟦Think of opening a storage box and picking only top-level items: retrieving a tool tucked away in a deep inner pouch requires explicitly naming it on the retrieval list.⟧

items.original: Changed how directory entries in `skills.json`, `rules.json`, `agents.json`, and `plugins.json` are scanned: an entry now loads only the items directly inside the directory, the same as a `.agents/skills/` folder, instead of recursively loading everything beneath it; to load a nested item, name it in `include_only`, for example `{"path": "shared_skills", "include_only": ["category/my-skill"]}`

title.zh-TW: 無頭模式串流中斷回傳錯誤退出碼，JSON 輸出保留部分回覆
title.en: Headless Mode Streaming Errors Now Return Exit Code 3 While JSON Output Retains Partial Responses

body.zh-TW: 把命令列工具放進自動化腳本跑任務時，最怕遇到程式半途出錯卻假裝成功。在以 `-p` 或 `--prompt` 執行的無頭模式（headless，沒有終端機畫面的自動執行模式）下，以前若串流輸出中途因模型或助理出錯中斷，程式仍會帶著代表成功的代碼 0 結束。現在這類異常會正確改以退出碼 `3` 結束並印出 `AGY_ERROR` 錯誤行，JSON 錯誤輸出中也會保留出錯前已生成的局部內容，多輪 `stream-json` 工作階段則維持發出警告並繼續執行。
body.en: When running the CLI in automation scripts, silent failures that masquerade as success are a major pitfall. In headless mode executed with `-p` or `--prompt`, streaming outputs interrupted by model or agent errors previously exited with code 0 indicating success. Such failures now properly exit with code `3` and print an `AGY_ERROR` line, while JSON error output preserves the partial response generated prior to the failure, and multi-turn `stream-json` sessions continue to warn and proceed.

items.original: Fixed headless (`-p` / `--prompt`) runs that streamed part of a response and then ended on a model or agent error exiting with code 0; they now exit with code `3` and print the `AGY_ERROR` line, and JSON error output includes the partial response, while multi-turn `stream-json` sessions still warn and continue

title.zh-TW: 舊版遠端控制升級後不再重複當機，自動取消廢棄服務
title.en: Upgraded Legacy Remote Control Installations No Longer Crash Loop and Unregister Deprecated Services

body.zh-TW: 以前使用舊版 Remote Control 安裝腳本設定的機器，在升級版本後常會陷入不斷崩潰重啟的無窮迴圈。現在當命令列工具被該已廢棄的舊版背景服務啟動時，會自動取消註冊該背景服務，並提示改用 `remote-control start` 指令啟動，徹底解決升級後反覆當機重開的問題。
body.en: Machines configured with legacy Remote Control installer scripts previously fell into infinite crash loops after upgrading. When the CLI is launched by that deprecated background service, it now automatically unregisters the background service and prompts switching to the `remote-control start` command, completely resolving crash loops after upgrades.

items.original: Fixed machines set up with the old Remote Control installer script crash-looping after an upgrade; when the CLI is launched by that deprecated background service it now unregisters the service and points to `remote-control start` instead of restarting repeatedly

title.zh-TW: 子代理工作樹檔案不再誤當成品，隔離存放避免殘留元資料
title.en: Subagent Worktree Files Are No Longer Mistaken for Artifacts to Prevent Metadata Residue

body.zh-TW: 呼叫背景助手平行處理程式碼時，專案目錄不再被莫名其妙的說明檔弄亂。以前在 Git 工作樹（worktree，讓同一專案平行開多份副本的功能）中寫入一般檔案時，系統會誤以為那是產物，強制要求附帶描述並留下 `.metadata.json` 檔案。現在子代理的工作樹統一移至資料目錄下的 `worktrees/` 資料夾，這個問題已經修好。
body.en: When invoking background agents to work on code in parallel, project directories will no longer be cluttered with unexpected metadata files. Previously, writing standard files inside a Git worktree caused the system to mistake them for artifacts, demanding descriptions and leaving `.metadata.json` files behind. Subagent worktrees now reside under a unified `worktrees/` folder in the app data directory, resolving this issue.

items.original: Fixed files that subagents write inside their own Git worktree being treated as artifacts, which demanded artifact metadata and left `.metadata.json` files in the worktree; subagent worktrees now live under a `worktrees/` directory in the app data directory

title.zh-TW: 心電圖面板字級對齊其他主題，專案明細不再偏小
title.en: ECG popover font sizes align with other themes so project details are no longer undersized

body.zh-TW: 當你切換到心電圖面板追蹤用量時，專案清單與底部的文字讀起來更協調了。⟦像看銀行寄來的對帳單，以前總額底下的一筆筆明細被印得特別小，上下對照總覺得比例失調；現在各欄位字級調整一致，一眼望去就能看清每筆收支。⟧以前在這個主題中，專案名稱、token（AI 處理與計費的文字單位）數、金額、專案動作按鈕、狀態列、今日金額與頁尾按鈕，字級原本都比平常小了 1 到 3px。這些文字放在大號額度讀數下方時顯得很突兀，現在心電圖面板的專案用量與頁尾字級已調回正常大小，與其他主題保持一致。
body.en: When you switch to the ECG popover to track usage, text across the project list and bottom section now reads with greater visual balance. ⟦Picture reviewing a bank statement where individual line items below the total were previously printed unusually small, creating an awkward visual contrast; now all fields share a consistent font size so you can clearly scan every expense at a glance.⟧ Previously in this theme, project names, token counts, costs, project action buttons, the status bar, today's total, and footer buttons were all 1 to 3px smaller than usual. That text looked out of place beneath the large quota readout, but project usage and footer font sizes in the ECG popover have now been restored to their standard scale, staying consistent with all other themes.

items.original: Bring the Heart Monitor panel's project list and footer text up to the size every other theme uses. Project names, token counts, costs, the project actions, the status strip, today's total and the footer buttons were 1–3px smaller and looked out of place under the large quota readouts.

title.zh-TW: 心電圖面板重整專案用量與頁尾，按鈕即時連動狀態列設定
title.en: ECG Popover Reorganizes Project Usage and Footer with Real-Time Status-Line Sync

body.zh-TW: 想在終端機裡查看各專案的資源消耗時，現在心電圖面板能呈現更工整清晰的排版。⟦如同走進重新規畫的控制室，以前各項指標高低不一且按鈕各自為政，現在所有數值按欄位整齊排好，開關指示燈也直接與主系統連線同步。⟧心電圖面板的專案列已改為對齊的數據表，搭配細長條與外框名次標籤，讓用量多寡與排行一目了然。原本的三個專案動作整合成一組分段按鈕，按鈕亮起狀態會跟著真正的 status-line（顯示在終端機最底下的狀態列）設定走，避免顯示與背後設定脫節。底部頁尾換上精簡的狀態列樣式，而上方的額度卡片則維持原本外觀。
body.en: When checking resource consumption across projects in the terminal, the ECG popover now presents a cleaner, more organized layout. ⟦Picture stepping into a redesigned control room: where scattered meters and isolated switches once operated independently, all readings are now arranged in aligned columns and indicator lights stay in sync with the main system.⟧ The project rows in the ECG popover are now structured into an aligned data table with slender bars and boxed rank tags, making usage levels and rankings clear at a glance. The previous three project actions are consolidated into a segmented button group, and the active button state mirrors the actual status-line configuration to prevent display mismatch. The bottom footer adopts a streamlined status-line style, while the quota cards above retain their original appearance.

items.original: Tidy the Heart Monitor panel's project list and footer: project rows line up as a data table with thin bars and outlined rank chips, the three project actions form one segmented control whose lit state follows the real status-line setting, and the footer becomes a status strip. The quota cards keep their original look.

title.zh-TW: 說明文件與官網展示收錄手繪筆記與心電圖新主題
title.en: Documentation and Website Add Handdrawn and ECG Theme Previews

body.zh-TW: 想在挑選主題前先預覽介面外觀，現在不必親自安裝切換就能直接看見效果。⟦好比走進線上家具型錄，以前新推出的配色沒有附上實景展示，想看搭配只能買回家組裝；現在目錄首頁就放上情境輪播，一眼就能比對每套風格的實際質感。⟧說明文件裡的 README 主題展示（theme gallery，列出各種外觀風格的範例區）與官方網站的面板輪播，現在同步收錄了「手繪筆記」與「心電圖」兩款樣式。你可以在網頁上直接看清不同主題在面板上的排版細節，挑選順眼的風格後再套用到終端機環境中。
body.en: When previewing interface styles before picking a theme, you can now see the results directly without installing and switching themes yourself. ⟦Like flipping through an online furniture catalog where new color schemes previously lacked room previews and required assembling them at home, the homepage now provides an interactive carousel to compare the exact look of every style at a glance.⟧ The README theme gallery in the documentation and the popover carousel on the official website now include both the "Handdrawn" and "ECG" themes. You can inspect layout details across themes directly on the web and pick your favorite style before applying it to your terminal.

items.original: Add Sketchbook and Heart Monitor to the README theme gallery and to the website's panel carousel.

title.zh-TW: 心電圖面板主題登場，用量高低化為即時跳動波形
title.en: Heart Monitor popover theme debuts, turning quota usage into live pulsing waveforms

body.zh-TW: 在日常盯著各家模型額度時，你現在能用醫院監視器風格的畫面掌握消耗狀況。⟦像看跑車儀表板上的動態轉速表，以前查用量只能盯著單純的數字進度，現在消耗節奏直接化為起伏波形，用量越凶波峰跳得越急。⟧新加入的心電圖（Heart Monitor）主題採用深色網格背景。每一列額度旁邊都有一條持續捲動的心電圖與等寬大字讀數，當用量越高，波峰會長得越高且跳動得越快。原本的 50% 與 80% 警示及危險配色，以及 80% 記號都完整保留。如果你在系統中開啟了「減少動態效果」，波形動畫就會貼心暫停。這項主題在 macOS 與 Windows 都能使用，讓可選的面板總數增加到 16 款。
body.en: When keeping an eye on model quotas each day, you can now track consumption with a hospital-monitor style interface. ⟦Picture a dynamic tachometer on a sports car dashboard: while you previously checked usage by staring at plain numeric progress, consumption rhythm is now rendered as an undulating waveform where heavier usage triggers faster, taller peaks.⟧ The newly added Heart Monitor theme features a dark grid background. Next to each quota row is a continuously scrolling ECG trace alongside large monospace readings; as usage rises, the peaks grow taller and pulse faster. The original warning and danger color schemes for 50% and 80%, along with the 80% marker, are fully preserved. If you have "Reduce Motion" enabled in your system settings, the waveform animation pauses automatically. This theme is available on macOS and Windows, bringing the total number of selectable themes to 16.

items.original: **Heart Monitor panel theme.** A hospital-monitor look on a dark grid: every quota row scrolls an ECG trace whose peaks grow taller and faster as usage rises, next to a large monospace readout. The 50% / 80% warning and danger colors and the 80% mark still apply, and the animation stops when Reduce Motion is on. Available on macOS and Windows; the panel count is now 16.

title.zh-TW: Windows 面板視窗精準貼合內容，放大文字不再冒出多餘捲軸
title.en: Windows popover window fits content accurately, eliminating unwanted scrollbars when scaling text

body.zh-TW: 當你在 Windows 調大文字大小，開啟面板不會再看到擠在邊緣的垂直捲軸。⟦照片接連放大兩次，若相框只照第一次尺寸做，邊緣仍會被擠住；按最後尺寸做才裝得下。⟧這是先前視窗問題（[#153]）的後續改進。若 Windows「文字大小」非 100%，會在顯示縮放外疊加 WebView2 縮放倍率（如 125% 乘 109% 達 1.3625）。舊版 `GetDpiForWindow` 未計入這層放大，使視窗比內容矮約 8% 而冒出捲軸，隱藏卡片也沒用。現在頁面會回報內容高度與 `devicePixelRatio`（實際顯示倍率），面板依此換算視窗大小、工作區、已存位置與可讀性下限，未回報前則退回顯示縮放。針對 pywebview 呼叫 `resize()` 與 `move()` 重複乘上縮放的問題，也依兩者比值補正。
body.en: When you increase text size on Windows, opening the popover will no longer display a vertical scrollbar crammed against the edge. ⟦When a photo is enlarged twice in succession, building the frame based only on the first resize still cramps the edges; only sizing it for the final dimensions makes everything fit.⟧ This is a follow-up improvement to a previous window issue ([#153]). If Windows "Text size" is not 100%, WebView2 zoom is compounded on top of display scaling, such as 125% multiplied by 109% reaching 1.3625. The legacy `GetDpiForWindow` did not account for this extra scaling layer, leaving the window roughly 8% shorter than its content and causing scrollbars to appear even if cards were hidden. The page now reports content height and `devicePixelRatio` (effective display scale), which the popover uses to calculate window dimensions, workspace, saved positions, and readability floors, falling back to display scale before reporting occurs. To address pywebview redundantly multiplying scaling on `resize()` and `move()` calls, values are corrected using the ratio between both scales.

items.original: Size the Windows panel from the scale its page is really rendered at, so it no longer scrolls when Windows' "Text size" is not 100% (a follow-up to [#153](https://github.com/aqua5230/usage/issues/153)). Text size multiplies WebView2's device pixel ratio on top of the display scale (125% × 109% = 1.3625), but `GetDpiForWindow` does not include it, so a window sized with the display scale alone came out about 8% shorter than its content: a scrollbar appeared although the screen had room to spare, and hiding a card did not help. The panel page now reports its `devicePixelRatio` together with its content height, and the window size, work area, saved position and legibility floor are converted with it, falling back to the display scale until the page has reported one. pywebview's `resize()` / `move()` multiply by the display scale themselves, so they are corrected by the ratio between the two.

title.zh-TW: Linux 上用 APT 或 RPM 裝的 gh 要認新金鑰
title.en: gh installed via APT or RPM on Linux needs the new signing key

body.zh-TW: 你在 Linux 上更新 `gh`，卻突然裝不起來、報簽章驗證失敗？多半是金鑰換了。GitHub CLI 的 APT 與 RPM 套件庫（Linux 下載與更新軟體的官方來源），連同個別的 RPM 套件檔，現在只用新的 PGP 金鑰簽署，指紋是 `7F38BBB59D064DBCB3D84D725612B36462313325`。如果你在 2026 年 4 月 8 日前從官方 APT 或 RPM 套件庫裝了 `gh`，又還沒更新金鑰圈（電腦裡記著哪些簽章可以信任的清單），安裝或更新就可能失敗。⟦就像快遞改用新封條，你家警衛只認得舊封條，包裹就會被擋在門外，得先把新封條的樣子告訴警衛。⟧照官方的 PGP 簽章金鑰輪換說明檢查、更新金鑰圈就能解決。用 Windows、macOS，或透過 Homebrew、GitHub Releases、其他套件管理器、原始碼安裝的人不受影響。
body.en: Updating `gh` on Linux and suddenly getting a signature verification failure? The signing key most likely changed. GitHub CLI's APT and RPM repositories, along with individual RPM packages, are now signed only with the new PGP key, fingerprint `7F38BBB59D064DBCB3D84D725612B36462313325`. If you installed `gh` from the official APT or RPM repositories before April 8, 2026 and haven't refreshed your keyring, installs and updates may fail. ⟦It's like a courier switching to a new seal: your building's guard only knows the old one, so packages get turned away until you show the guard what the new seal looks like.⟧ Follow the official PGP signing key rotation guidance to check and update your keyring. Users on Windows or macOS, and anyone who installed through Homebrew, GitHub Releases, another package manager, or from source, are not affected.

items.original:
## Linux package repository signing key rotation

GitHub CLI's APT and RPM repositories, along with individual RPM packages, are now signed only with the new PGP key (fingerprint: `7F38BBB59D064DBCB3D84D725612B36462313325`)

> [!IMPORTANT]
> Linux users who installed `gh` from the official APT or RPM repositories before April 8, 2026, and have not refreshed their keyring, may now see package installation or update failures. Follow the [PGP signing key rotation guidance](https://github.com/cli/cli/issues/13118) to check and update your keyring. Users on Windows or macOS, and users who installed `gh` through Homebrew, GitHub Releases, another package manager, or from source, are not affected.

title.zh-TW: gh 登入時自動幫你複製驗證碼
title.en: gh now copies your login code for you

body.zh-TW:
用 `gh auth login` 登入 GitHub，或用 `gh auth refresh` 更新權限時，畫面會給你一組 OAuth 裝置代碼（要貼到瀏覽器授權頁、證明是你本人在登入的短碼）。以前你得自己反白、複製，再切到瀏覽器貼上；現在這兩個指令預設會直接把代碼放進剪貼簿，切過去按貼上就好。⟦櫃檯人員直接把號碼牌塞到你手上，你就不必再拿筆抄一次號碼。⟧不想要這個行為，可以用下面這行永久關掉：

```shell
gh config set clipboard disabled
```

某一次執行時如果你另外指定了剪貼簿選項，那一次就照你指定的來。
body.en:
When you sign in with `gh auth login` or refresh permissions with `gh auth refresh`, the screen gives you an OAuth device code to paste into the browser's authorization page. You used to highlight it, copy it, then switch to the browser and paste. Now both commands put the code on your clipboard by default, so you just switch over and paste. ⟦Think of a service desk where the clerk hands you the ticket instead of making you copy the number down with a pen.⟧ To turn this off for good, run:

```shell
gh config set clipboard disabled
```

If you pass an explicit clipboard option on a single run, that run follows your choice.

items.original:
## Copy authentication codes to the clipboard by default

`gh auth login` and `gh auth refresh` now copy OAuth device codes to the clipboard by default, saving a manual copy step during authentication.

To persistently opt out, run:

```shell
gh config set clipboard disabled
```

Explicit clipboard options still take precedence for an individual invocation.

title.zh-TW: GitHub API 流量支援自訂閘道，身分驗證與網址維持直連
title.en: GitHub API Traffic Supports Custom Gateways, While Authentication and URLs Remain Direct

body.zh-TW:
企業若需要稽核或集中管控網路流量，現在可以透過個別主機的 `api_host` 設定，將 GitHub API 請求導向自訂閘道（gateway，把流量轉去另一個位址再送出的中繼點）。這項改動只會轉發 API 呼叫，登入身分驗證、Git 遠端儲存庫操作與瀏覽器開啟網址仍會直接連線至原始主機。此功能目前仍處於實驗階段，且不是安全邊界，部分請求可能依然會送往原始主機。

```
# 設定將 github.com 的 API 流量轉發至自訂閘道
gh config set api_host gh-gateway.example.com --host github.com

# 查詢特定主機目前設定的 API 閘道位址
gh config get api_host --host github.com
```

⟦這就像公司設立的公務收發室，員工採購與查詢資料等業務公文統一由專屬窗口轉交處理，但員工出勤打卡、私人包裹寄送與親自拜訪仍直接走大樓正門。⟧
body.en:
Organizations that need to audit or centrally manage network traffic can now route GitHub API requests to a custom gateway via the per-host `api_host` setting. This change only forwards API calls; login authentication, Git remote repository operations, and browser-opened URLs still connect directly to the original host. This feature is currently experimental and is not a security boundary, so some requests may still reach the original host.

```
# Set up forwarding API traffic for github.com to a custom gateway
gh config set api_host gh-gateway.example.com --host github.com

# Query the currently configured API gateway address for a specific host
gh config get api_host --host github.com
```

⟦This is like a company mailroom for official business, where business documents such as procurement requests and data inquiries are routed through a dedicated counter, while employee clock-ins, personal parcel deliveries, and in-person visits still go directly through the building's main entrance.⟧

items.original:
## Experimental: Route GitHub API traffic through a custom host

Organizations can now route a GitHub host's API traffic through a gateway using the new per-host `api_host` configuration:

```shell
# Route API traffic for github.com through a gateway
gh config set api_host gh-gateway.example.com --host github.com

# Read the configured API host
gh config get api_host --host github.com
```

The original host remains in use for authentication, Git remotes, and browser URLs.

> [!NOTE]
> `api_host` is experimental and is not a security boundary. Requests may still reach the original host.

title.zh-TW: 在命令列直接把截圖和影片附進 issue 與 PR
title.en: Attach screenshots and videos to issues and PRs from the command line

body.zh-TW:
⟦你把沖洗好的照片一張張貼進日誌本，寫到哪一頁就貼在哪一頁；頁面上原本寫著「照片放這裡」的位置，照片會直接蓋上去，其他頁則往後補貼。⟧回報問題時想附一張截圖，以前得先開網頁上傳。現在 `gh` 多了 `--attach`，直接把本機的圖片和影片傳上去，接進 issue、pull request 或留言的內文。

```shell
gh issue create --attach './repro.png#The error state'
gh pr comment 456 --attach ./result.mp4
```

內文若已經寫到那個本機路徑，`gh` 會把它換成上傳後的網址；沒寫到就補在最後。同一次指令要附多個檔案，就重複寫幾次這個旗標。這功能在 GitHub.com 與 GitHub Enterprise Cloud 上都能用。
body.en:
⟦You paste developed photos into a logbook page by page: where a page already says "photo goes here", the print covers that spot; elsewhere it goes on at the end.⟧ Reporting a bug with a screenshot used to mean opening the web page to upload it first. `gh` now has `--attach`, which uploads local images and videos and puts them into the body of an issue, a pull request, or a comment.

```shell
gh issue create --attach './repro.png#The error state'
gh pr comment 456 --attach ./result.mp4
```

If the body already references that local path, `gh` swaps in the uploaded URL; otherwise the attachment is appended. Repeat the flag to attach several files in one invocation. Attachments work on GitHub.com and GitHub Enterprise Cloud.

items.original:
## Attach images and videos to issues and pull requests

The repeatable `--attach` flag uploads local images and videos and adds them to issue, pull request, or comment bodies. If a body already references the local path, `gh` replaces it with the uploaded URL; otherwise it appends the attachment:

```shell
# Attach files when creating or editing an issue
gh issue create --attach './repro.png#The error state'
gh issue edit 123 --attach ./walkthrough.mp4

# Attach files when creating or editing a pull request
gh pr create --attach ./before.png
gh pr edit 456 --attach ./after.png

# Attach files to comments
gh issue comment 123 --attach ./repro.png
gh pr comment 456 --attach ./result.mp4
```

Repeat the flag to attach multiple files in a single invocation. Attachments are available on GitHub.com and GitHub Enterprise Cloud.

For more information see https://gh.io/gh-attach and https://github.blog/changelog/2026-09-01-github-cli-media-in-issues-pull-requests-and-comments/

title.zh-TW: `gh issue develop` 能另開工作目錄，手上的東西不用收
title.en: `gh issue develop` can check the branch out in a separate worktree

body.zh-TW:
手邊的改動改到一半，issue 那頭又要你開一條新分支——以前得先收拾現場才能切過去。現在 `gh issue develop` 可以幫 issue 建好連動的分支，並且把它簽出到一個新的 Git worktree（工作樹，讓同一專案平行開多份副本的功能），你目前這份工作目錄原封不動。

```shell
gh issue develop 123 --checkout --worktree /path/to/wt-feature
```

⟦工地要趕另一項工程時，不必把現場拆掉重排，而是在旁邊另闢一塊作業區，兩邊同時進行。⟧
body.en:
You are halfway through a change when an issue needs a fresh branch, and until now you had to tidy up before switching over. `gh issue develop` can now create the linked branch for an issue and check it out in a new Git worktree, a second working copy of the same project that stands on its own, leaving your current working copy untouched.

```shell
gh issue develop 123 --checkout --worktree /path/to/wt-feature
```

⟦When a site has to start a second job, the crew does not tear down what is already laid out; they open a separate work area beside it and run both at once.⟧

items.original:
## Worktree support extended to `gh issue develop` 

`gh issue develop` can now create a linked branch and check it out in a new Git worktree, leaving your current working copy unchanged:

```shell
# Create a linked branch for an issue and check it out in a worktree
gh issue develop 123 --checkout --worktree /path/to/wt-feature
```
